visnet_state.name: C1
visnet_state.definition: accumulated scalar/vector state after message-passing layers 0,1,2

atomic_invariant_descriptor.definition: concat(x, Euclidean norm of each vector channel over xyz)

residue_readout.sidechain_definition: all expected ATOM14 heavy atoms other than N/CA/C/O
residue_readout.gly_handling: S is an exact 128D zero vector and sidechain_present is false
residue_readout.pooling: equal mean over available expected heavy atoms in each group

temporal.muZ: mean of BS over exactly 20 ordered stored frames
temporal.muDelta: mean of the 19 signed DeltaZ vectors; equals (BS_last-BS_first)/19
temporal.rmsDelta: elementwise sqrt(mean of squared 19 DeltaZ vectors)

residue_ordering: 270 receptor residues in authenticated sequence/embedding_index order; no sorting or reindexing
frame_ordering: strict archived frame_ids within each replica/condition/window; five contiguous blocks [0:20],[20:40],[40:60],[60:80],[80:100]
scientific_claim: representation definition only; no biological efficacy claim
